description: This file defines various warning reporting categories as classes within the Thunder::WarningReporting namespace. Each class represents a specific warning or error condition related to system performance or resource management, such as long lock waits, RPC delays, or job timeouts. The classes include serialization/deserialization methods, ToString methods for reporting, and static bounds for warnings and reports.

classes.name: TooLongWaitingForLock
classes.description: Represents a warning for excessively long wait times to acquire a lock.

classes.name: SinkStillHasReference
classes.description: Represents a warning when a sink still holds a reference during destruction.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeRPC
classes.description: Represents a warning for RPC calls that take too long.

classes.name: JobTooLongToFinish
classes.description: Indicates a job that took too long to complete.

classes.name: JobTooLongWaitingInQueue
classes.description: Indicates a job waiting in queue for too long.

classes.name: JobActiveForTooLong
classes.description: Indicates a job that has been active for an excessively long duration.

classes.name: SocketOperationTooLong
classes.description: Warns about socket operations that exceed expected duration.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the class data into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into class members.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a string description of the warning, including actual and maximum values.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes interface and method IDs for RPC warning class.
